subject.title: fix(sqlite): reject schema data loss during upgrades

question: Should OpenClaw advance shared state from v5 to v6 and agent state from v14 to v15 so that missing stable schema tables fail closed during upgrades rather than being silently recreated?
rationale: This is an intentional persistent-data compatibility boundary: the correct set of historical additive tables and acceptable operator failure modes depends on maintainer ownership of the shipped upgrade contract.

options.title: Approve the fail-closed versioned migration
options.body: Confirm the historical schema exceptions are complete and merge the explicit preflight guards as the canonical upgrade contract.

options.title: Preserve a broader upgrade path
options.body: Define an additional explicitly supported historical schema shape and add a narrow migration plus regression coverage before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve the fail-closed versioned migration
recommendation.body: Confirm the historical schema exceptions are complete and merge the explicit preflight guards as the canonical upgrade contract.
